[SWS_SM_00208] prepare rollback
Upstream requirements:
RS_SM_00004
⌈
State Management
shall provide the service interface
UpdateRequest
to
Update
and Configuration Management
with the method call
PrepareRollback
thus it
can request
State Management
to perform a preparation of the given
Function
Groups
to be rolled back.
⌋
For updating a
Software Cluster Update and Configuration Management
will call the method
PrepareUpdate
(as part of the service interface
Up-
dateRequest
) in a first step.
State Management
will at least set all the
Function
Groups
, given as parameter, to Off state. In next step
Update and Configura-
tion Management
will perform the real update (e.g. exchange executable, change
manifests,...). As following step
Update and Configuration Management
uses
the
VerifyUpdate
to request
State Management
to perform a verification of the
update. Therefore
State Management
will at least set all the
Function Groups
,
given as parameter, to Verify state. These request will be reported to
Update and
Configuration Management
as failed when any of the
Function Groups
could
not be set to the requested
Function Group State
. A failure will also be reported
